checks.description: Which checks to run; default both.

image.description: Serving image to probe. Required when probe is requested.

fix.description: Let preflight create the namespace and install GAIE CRDs.

selector.description: Pod labels of an adopted fleet. When present the probe runs inside one matching pod (`deploy probe --selector`) instead of a Job, because the fleet already holds the chips and the running pod is the image under study.

sim.description: The recipe's engine_flavor is sim: preflight reports missing TPU nodes as a warning, and the probe declares the simulator's capabilities instead of running.

examples.prompt: Verify the cluster and image for the study.
